messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: we've seen OOMs in eu-west multi-tenant when customers send very long multimodal prompts. Minimal hotpatch ready: image bump + tokenizer guard (v2.3.9-hotfix). No DB or client changes. Need a short maintenance window tonight 00:30-01:00 UTC. Plan: smoke -> 3% canary -> 100% (10m ramp) if metrics are green. Auto-rollback criteria: 0.3% 5xx over 1m OR container memory > 78% for 2m.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued from @sam
- image: `redwood/serving:2.3.9-hotfix`
- targets: eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool
- strategy: staged canary (3% -> 100%)
- smoke: `smoke/multi-tenant-longprompt` (1k token run)
- rollback probe: `5xx_rate>0.3%||mem_pct>78`

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @nora (priority) 3: please ack to avoid auto-escalation.

nora: acked. I'll be on watch for the window and can hit rollback if the probe trips.

claire: I can give fast approval conditional on an automated rollback gate and a short release note for ops.

sam: added webhook-based rollback + prometheus probe. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/multitenant-oom. Release note draft below.

albert: small nit: include which pools are pinned and whether the canary includes dedicated tenants.

sam: canary only hits multi-tenant pool, not dedicated tenants. Will pin dedicated to 2.3.8 until verified.

claire: :+1: approve expedited roll. Please include the dedicated-pin command in the PR.

sam: release note: "2.3.9-hotfix: prevent serializer OOM on long multimodal prompts in eu-west multi-tenant pool. No client changes."

deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window -> start 1850000000 (canary 3%). CLI preview:

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.3.9-hotfix \
  --targets eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 3 --canary-duration 10m \
  --smoke smoke/multi-tenant-longprompt --rollback-probe "5xx>0.3||mem>78"
```

sam: kicking smoke now, will post results in ~90s.

(90s later)
sam: smoke clean. no errors, mem stable. starting 3% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 3% at 1850000030. Observability hooks live.

nora: monitoring traces and node mem. nothing alarming so far.

(8m later)
sam: ramping to 100% now per fast-approve. will watch for 15m before closing the window.

deploy-bot: Ramp complete: 100% at 1850000480.

nora: post-ramp checks look good: 5xx at baseline, mem usage healthy. No rollback needed.

albert: thanks all. can someone add the dedicated-pin command to the PR and leave a short post-deploy note for support?

sam: done: dedicated pinned to 2.3.8 with command in PR, and post-deploy note added with links to traces and the runbook. Closing window in 15m. :rocket:
